OPTION C / GROWTH

Proficiency ladder

A progression view using observable signals instead of years of experience.

Skill: Facilitation and alignment

Developing

Uses a known workshop structure, captures open questions, and needs help resolving disagreement.

Independent

Chooses the right activity, brings the right people together, and makes tradeoffs visible.

Advanced

Adapts the approach to ambiguity, improves the team’s decision system, and coaches others.

OPTION D / DEPTH

Expanded skill profile

A deeper page for understanding one skill, its evidence, and how to validate it.

Skill profile

Definition

Turn competing signals into a clear decision frame that the team can act on.

Observable actions

  • Frames the problem before polishing the solution
  • Names assumptions, constraints, and unknowns
  • Checks that the decision has a clear owner

Tools and artifacts

Workshop board, research repository, analytics dashboard, decision log.

Evidence + validation

Synthesized from the role’s workflows. Validate with a portfolio review or a live framing exercise.

What each direction is good for

Cards are best for scanning. Matrix is best for seeing relationships. Ladder is best for development. Profile is best for deep understanding. Skills inside flows is best when capabilities should stay grounded in the work. Skill index + deep dive combines the quick scan with focused detail, so it is a strong default for a persona page.
